waypoints.title: Define the doc-comment contract
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Specify concise purpose, behavior or responsibility, intent, relationships, and constraints for each discoverable Rust item kind. Preserve the boundary: Distinguish useful explanation from implementation restatement; define structure, length, unsupported kinds, and justified exceptions.
non_goals: Do not document the whole workspace or refactor source.

validation.command: Review representative functions, types, constants, traits, implementations, and modules without inventing behavior.

waypoints.title: Build the documentation health check
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Inventory selected modules and report missing, malformed, vague, overlong, or unsupported documentation with stable status over time. non_goals: Do not silently rewrite comments or modify Rust source.

waypoints.title: Review semantic duplicate candidates
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Compare normalized documented intent to find likely redundant behavior and missing abstraction opportunities. Preserve the boundary: Similarity narrows the search; evidence must retain element links and candidates remain distinct from confirmed redundancy.
non_goals: Do not automatically merge, delete, generalize, or mutate implementations.

validation.command: Compare exact duplicates, related-but-distinct items, and overlapping vocabulary with unrelated behavior.
